changed: execution_ir on, single-step plans. DriverInput.allowed_capabilities narrows the driver's tools per run; the gateway refuses a driver read and ir_on refuses a proposal outside the set (verifier host reads stay unnarrowed). The admitted TaskDefinition is snapshotted in the continuation at admission and used for the whole run (tool set, TTL, budgets, plan compile, acceptance); a bound run without a snapshot gets an empty tool set. A validated proposal compiles to a 1-step plan, stored with put_plan; the action carries plan_id/step_index; approval digest and presentation equal off; step records for validate, approval_wait, dispatch and verify. Fallback before the first reservation with fixed codes (an API run falls back once at admission). Run-end acceptance: ReasonCode.ACCEPTANCE_UNMET with a KERNEL-ACCEPTANCE finding, on the live finish and in recovery. Stores refuse an action whose plan_id names no plan of its run. In on, build_runtime refuses startup for a definition capability tool_specs cannot offer. The Coordinator's on-guard is removed. ui-core i18n for the new reason code.

on refuses startup for a profile whose bindings span two connections (answers inherit every connection); kernel routing for answers is later work.
